name: print-social-attention-please-notice-card-glass-exclamation-icon-purple
title: 'Attention Please' notice post with a frosted glass card and a glossy 3D glass exclamation-mark icon
whatItIs: A dark purple striped post with a frosted-glass rounded card holding a bold 'Attention Please' headline and an office-closure announcement, flanked by two glossy translucent 3D triangle icons with exclamation marks, and Instagram action icons along the bottom.
whatItMeans: Clear and polite; the glass card format gives even an inconvenient announcement (a closure notice) a premium, considerate presentation.
techniques: Present an announcement inside a frosted glass card for gravity.
Use glossy 3D warning icons instead of flat ones for a premium feel.
Keep text concise and apologetic in tone for closure notices.

vocabulary.definition: A card format used to deliver an official announcement.
A glossy rendered exclamation or alert symbol.
